plan: Model the check-in as a single CheckInConsole class holding a defensively copied appointment list and the public four-field session dict, mutated only after full validation.

Route handle(action) through a type-to-handler dispatch table; each handler runs guard checks first and returns an error screen (first message prefixed 'Error:') without touching state when any guard fails.

Centralize screen construction in one factory that fills prompt/messages/choices and attaches appointment choices exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment', so the invariant holds for accepted and error screens alike.
Derive prompts from session state with a next-unmet-step function (contact, then appointment, then review), reused for corrections and for error-screen prompts to keep output deterministic.

Expose run_once() over injected action_source/screen_sink duck-typed ports (read_action/display), raising RuntimeError before any I/O call when either is missing, enabling plain standard-library unittest fakes.
mechanisms: Dependency-injected I/O ports (action_source.read_action, screen_sink.display) for test-double substitution
Dispatch table mapping action type strings to handler methods
Guard-then-commit validation: state is mutated only after all checks pass
Single screen factory enforcing the prompt/messages/choices shape and the choices-only-on-'Choose appointment' invariant
Next-unmet-prompt derivation function shared by corrections and error screens
In-place session reset from a frozen initial-state template for begin/abandon
